name: miniflux
title: Miniflux
description: Feed reader for RSS and Atom that is small and fast: it fetches the full text of articles, strips trackers, and works with phone and desktop readers through the Fever and Google Reader APIs. After deploying, sign in with the user name and password you set below.

variables.name: MINIFLUX_BASE_URL
variables.label: Public address
variables.description: The address people open, like https://rss.example.com. Leave empty and DCS uses this deploy's route, or this server's address and the port above

variables.name: MINIFLUX_ADMIN_USER
variables.label: Admin user name
variables.description: The first account, made at the first start

variables.name: MINIFLUX_ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.label: Admin password
variables.description: Its password, at least 6 characters. Only used at the first start: change it later in Miniflux itself

variables.name: MINIFLUX_DB_PASSWORD
variables.label: Database password
variables.description: Leave empty and DCS generates one on deploy

auth_note: Not put behind Authelia: feed reader apps sign in directly through its API (the deploy sheet can still protect it)
